purpose: Teach: 酔い/湿気/寒かっ/叱ら/落ち込み/思い浮かべ/縁起/引っ張る

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃の飲み会、酔いも忘れて朝まで踊ったな。
lines.en: In my younger days, I'd dance till morning at those drinking parties—completely forgot I was even drunk.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. A small smile in the voice. Patient pacing, letting the memory settle. Gentle warmth, not performed but genuine.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。あの夏、湿気で大変だったわね。
lines.en: Yes. That summer was so humid, wasn't it—I remember how hard it was.
lines.style: Warm agreement, intimate. A quiet laugh underneath. Leans into the shared memory. Breath easy, voice relaxed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 戦後、本当に寒かった年がいくつもあった。
lines.en: After the war, there were several years that were truly bitter cold.
lines.style: Distant but not cold. The words carry weight without heaviness. Measured pace. Eyes looking back, not down.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お父さんに叱られた思い出、つい笑える。
lines.en: Being scolded by my father—the memory still makes me laugh now.
lines.style: Soft exhale before speaking. Genuine small laugh underneath. Affectionate tone, not regretful. Light trailing at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 落ち込みっぱなしの日もあったが、二人で乗り越えた。
lines.en: There were days I felt nothing but despair, but we got through them together.
lines.style: Steady, grounded voice. The kind of honesty that doesn't ask for sympathy. Slow, deliberate delivery. Warmth underneath the difficulty.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 結婚式の写真、思い浮かべると、まだ感動するわ。
lines.en: When I picture our wedding photos, I still feel moved by them.
lines.style: Quiet wonder in the opening. Voice softens on the image. Breath shallow with emotion, not performed. A pause before 'moved' as the feeling settles.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 子供たちの縁起担ぎ、私たちも続けたな。
lines.en: The little superstitions the kids came up with—we carried them forward too.
lines.style: Gentle, slightly amused remembrance. Small smile audible. Even pacing, unhurried. Warmth that speaks of continuation and care.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 重い荷物、若い頃も引っ張る役、よくお願いしたわね。
lines.en: Heavy bags and parcels—you were always the one I asked to carry them when we were young.
lines.style: Tender, almost teasing warmth. A laugh waiting at the edges. Comfortable rhythm, like picking up mid-conversation. Gratitude woven through.
